name: Futaai Miyoko
source:
Akane's youthful mother. Miyoko is the proprietress of Osaki eel restaurant, alongside her husband Makoto, its owner. She is well-liked by her colleagues due to her cheery and positive attitude. After collapsing from exhaustion during work, Miyoko is hospitalised, but remains in a stable condition- her collapse wasn't a sign of anything life-threatening.
[CV: SaRara (friend of the developer's, not a professional voice actress)]
